name: Twincantation
source:
Twincantation is a handmade visual novel where you play a teen sneaking onto private property to hold a seance for your twin sister who died under mysterious circumstances. The unique aspect to this game is that you can choose between a horror path vs. an emotional, reflective path. Available on Steam for Windows, Mac and Steamdeck.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Twincantation》是一部手工制作的视觉小说，你扮演一个青少年偷偷溜进私人领地，为你神秘死亡的双胞胎妹妹举行降神会。这款游戏的独特之处在于，你可以在恐怖路径和情感、反思路径之间进行选择。适用于Windows、Mac和Steamdeck的Steam。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877760/]Steam[/url]]
